description: Java class implementing an AMQP endpoint for managing device registration information within the Eclipse Hono project. It extends a request-response endpoint to handle messaging for device registration over AMQP, interacting with the Vert.x event bus.

classes.name: RegistrationAmqpEndpoint
classes.description: A request-response AMQP endpoint for device registration, extending the generic endpoint class to handle registration-specific messaging logic.

methods.name: RegistrationAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the endpoint with a Vertx instance.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the registration endpoint.

methods.name: getEventBusServiceAddress
methods.description: Returns the specific address on the Vert.x event bus for registration messages.

methods.name: createEventBusRequestMessage
methods.description: Creates a structured EventBusMessage from an AMQP message, resource target, and client info; handles JSON decoding and error propagation.

methods.name: passesFormalVerification
methods.description: Checks whether a message passes registration-specific validation criteria.

methods.name: getAmqpReply
methods.description: Constructs an AMQP reply message based on the processed EventBusMessage.
